note: The hand-written (literal WSP) releases this deployment serves: one entry per release, its bytes in models/<hex>/ beside this file. limits: On CFI-G validation with the planned stop it is worse than the model before it (sum 0.2271 against 0.2191, two sessions).
On the Flame Design validation days every normal-flame case ended by a flow stop, so extinction there only measures false extinction; two or three validation days are few.
A nitrogen-diluted ethylene flame lives longer than the growth law says; ethylene below 1900 K is refused.
The endpoint method misplaces the flow change on tests with an ignition-to-test ramp.

Also covers Flame Design (PSI-10, ethylene from the typed fuel table) and s-Flame (PSI-23) as a blind transfer: on s-Flame validation days the sum 0.262 against 0.279 for the incidence baseline is undecided; helium, hydrogen and blends are refused (docs/wsp/COVERAGE_19.md on the lane branch).
